meta.name: correlating-security-events-in-qradar
meta.description: Correlates security events in IBM QRadar SIEM using AQL (Ariel Query Language), custom rules, building blocks, and offense management to detect multi-stage attacks across network, endpoint, and application log sources. Use when SOC analysts need to investigate QRadar offenses, build correlation rules, or tune detection logic for reducing false positives.

copy.tagline: 关联多源安全事件，检测复杂攻击链
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在QRadar中编写关联规则并分析多阶段攻击。
copy.tagline_en: Correlate security events across sources to detect multi-stage attacks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write correlation rules and analyze multi-stage attacks in QRadar.
